long_biography.plain_text:
GoldCoast Logistics specialised in time-sensitive freight, moving food-grade products, trade-show materials and entertainment equipment. Dragos Sprinceana oversaw a purpose-built terminal in Elgin, Illinois, as the business expanded. It brought warehousing and offices together with overnight rooms for drivers who were in town for recruitment or training.

The rooms answered a practical cost problem: the company had been paying for hotels and local transport. Sprinceana used the building to bring several operating needs together on one site. GoldCoast later completed a sale-and-leaseback of the terminal, leaving the company as tenant while freeing capital for its business.
